ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it's known that $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, $PD$ is tangent to $\odot O$ at point C, and intersects the extension line of $AB$ at point D, and $\angle D=2\angle CAD$. Find the size of $\angle D$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect $OC$.\\
Since $\overset{\frown}{BC}=\overset{\frown}{BC}$,\\
it follows that $ \angle CAD=\frac{1}{2}\angle COB$, i.e., $ \angle COB=2\angle CAD$.\\
Since $ \angle D=2\angle CAD$,\\
it follows that $ \angle COB=\angle D$.\\
Since $ PD$ is tangent to $\odot O$,\\
it follows that $ OC\perp PD$, i.e., $ \angle OCD=90^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $ \angle COB+\angle D=90^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $ 2\angle D=90^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $ \angle D=\angle COB=\boxed{45^\circ}$.
